titulo: Most AI chatbots stay in the political middle ground, with Grok being an exception
cuerpo: The 2026 election was the first parliamentary election in Sweden since AI chatbots became a serious part of everyday life—not least for young people and first-time voters. Today, it is possible to turn to a number of services, such as ChatGPT, to get information about politics, reason about political issues or get help polishing arguments. Discussions have also arisen in society about whether political values are expressed in AI-generated texts and, if so, which ones.
